questions.q: What lenses do you look through, and where did you first pick them up?
questions.answer: One example: "A lot of how I see the world came from my family, but some probably came from friends and what I watch." It's worth asking where each piece came from.

questions.q: Where is your worldview a buffet, with pieces that don't fit together?
questions.answer: One honest example: "I say I believe the Bible, but on big questions I often just go with the top answer online, even when the two don't fit together."

questions.q: How do movies and music you love show a worldview without ever saying so?
questions.answer: The people who make them see the world a certain way, and it comes through in how a story treats big questions like what's real, what's right, or what happens at death.
